The '''Jatir system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Corulag-Jatir Hyperroute]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_2.html|Transport Collision Closes Corulag-Jatir Hyperroute}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jatir [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
